metadata.title: Kiraku
metadata.description: Open packs, collect anime character fuda and challenge your friends.

account.rateLimited: Too many accounts created from this connection. Try again in a while.
account.linkBody: You're playing as a guest: create your account so you never lose anything and get your collection on all your devices.
account.emailUnverified: Address not verified: open the link we emailed you.
account.discordBonusBody: Earn {amount, number} Zeni the first time you link it.

authError.title: Sign-in failed
authError.alreadyLinkedTitle: This Discord account is already in use
authError.alreadyLinkedBody: It's linked to another Kiraku account. If you continue, you'll get that account back and this device's guest progress will be dropped.
authError.generic: Signing in with Discord failed. Please try again in a moment.
authError.emailExistsTitle: This email address already has an account
authError.emailExistsBody: Sign in with your email and password, then link Discord from your account.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: Your guest progress is kept: same cards, same balance.

login.title: Sign in
login.guestWarning: You're playing as a guest on this device: signing in to another account will drop this guest progress.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, an email is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new reset email.

verify.title: Verify my address
verify.intro: Confirm that this email address belongs to you.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailTaken: This email address is already in use.
errors.tokenInvalid: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.subject: Kiraku: confirm your email address
verify.body:
Welcome to Kiraku!

Confirm your address by opening this link (valid for 48 hours):
{link}

If you didn't create an account, ignore this message.

reset.subject: Kiraku: new password
reset.body:
You asked to change your Kiraku password.

Choose a new one with this link (valid for 1 hour):
{link}

If this wasn't you, ignore this message: your password stays the same.

mail.disabled: Sending emails isn't enabled yet: no email was sent.
mail.devHint: In development, the link is printed in the server logs (the npm run dev terminal).
